BrochureContent.Content:
O’Connor Property Management are proud to present this exceptional first-floor apartment to the market. Situated within the prestigious Rockfield development, this beautifully presented residence combines generous proportions, contemporary style and an unbeatable location, making it an outstanding opportunity for owner-occupiers and investors alike.
From the moment you enter, the apartment conveys a wonderful sense of space and light. A welcoming entrance hall leads to an impressive open-plan living and dining room where large picture windows bathe the interior in natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Sliding doors open onto a private balcony – the perfect place to enjoy a morning coffee, dine al fresco or simply unwind overlooking the peaceful surroundings.

The separate fully fitted kitchen is both stylish and practical, offering excellent storage and workspace while remaining conveniently connected to the main living area.
There are two generously proportioned double bedrooms, both complete with fitted wardrobes. The principal bedroom benefits from a beautifully finished, fully tiled en-suite shower room, while the main bathroom is equally well appointed with quality sanitary ware, full tiling, a bath with overhead shower, recessed lighting, shaver socket and extractor fan.

Rockfield has long been recognised as one of South Dublin’s most desirable apartment developments, offering mature landscaped gardens, a secure and well-maintained environment and an enviable lifestyle on the doorstep of every convenience.
The location is simply superb. The LUAS Green Line is adjacent to the development, placing Dublin City Centre within approximately 10 minutes. Dundrum Town Centre is just a short walk away, offering one of Ireland’s finest selections of shopping, restaurants, cafés, cinemas and leisure facilities. The nearby M50 provides effortless access to all major routes and Dublin Airport, while Airfield Estate, Ballawley Park and a superb choice of renowned schools and colleges—including UCD, Wesley College, Mount Anville and St. Olaf’s National School—are all within easy reach.
